notes: SSC CHSL 2024 (10+2 cycle, CHSL 2023-24) Tier I (CBE) was conducted on 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10 and 11 July 2024 (revised schedule; the original window included 12-Jul-2024 which was dropped). Source: SSC revised exam-date notice reported 07/08-Jun-2024 by Shiksha, Moneycontrol, Utkarsh. SHIFT COUNT (updated 2026-08-24): 4 shifts per day (36 expected total) per Adda247's CHSL PYQ page, which hosts 4 direct CBE exam-screen export PDFs per date with explicit time windows (9:00-10:00 AM, 11:45 AM-12:45 PM, 2:30-3:30 PM, 5:15-6:15 PM) - e.g. 01-07-2024 objects 09175148/09175149/09175146/09175147. CONFLICT: prepp.in/sscadda list only 3 shifts for most dates; the Adda247 direct per-shift PDFs (one PDF per distinct time window) are the stronger evidence and are used here, conflict flagged.
